import gc
import json
import statistics
import sys
import time
import tracemalloc
from contextlib import nullcontext
from functools import partial
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch
sys.path.insert(0, '/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121/src')
from sdkbench.candidates.adapters import load_adapter, workflow_configuration
from sdkbench.candidates.applications import fixture
from sdkbench.p0 import Bundle
from sdkbench.p0.evaluators import routing
from benchmarks.compiler_sabre_native_cost import _select as previous
from benchmarks.compiler_sabre_trial_reuse import _select as reused
from flagquantum.compiler.topology import sabre

config = workflow_configuration('flagquantum-target-artifact')
budget = config['options']['max_native_added_operations']
selectors = {'production': None, 'previous': previous, 'reused': reused}
bundle = Bundle(Path('/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121/docs/implementation'))
rows = []
for width, family, topology in ((6,'qft','grid'), (6,'repetition','ring'), (12,'qft','grid')):
    f = fixture(width, family, topology, '01'*32)
    case = bundle.cases[f'ROUTE-LINE-{width:02d}']
    samples = {name: [] for name in selectors}
    payloads = {}
    counts = {}
    def run(name):
        adapter = load_adapter(SimpleNamespace(configuration={'options': {'sdk': config['sdk'], 'workflow': 'flagquantum-target-artifact', 'compiler_options': config}}))
        with (nullcontext() if selectors[name] is None else patch.object(sabre,'_select_sabre_trials',partial(selectors[name],native_budget=budget))):
            started = time.perf_counter()
            payload = adapter.execute('route',f,11)
            elapsed = time.perf_counter()-started
        return payload,elapsed
    for _ in range(2):
        for name in selectors:
            run(name)
    names = list(selectors)
    for iteration in range(7):
        for name in names[iteration%3:]+names[:iteration%3]:
            payload,elapsed = run(name)
            samples[name].append(elapsed)
            payloads[name] = payload
    allocations = {}
    for name in selectors:
        gc.collect()
        tracemalloc.start()
        try:
            run(name)
            allocations[name] = tracemalloc.get_traced_memory()[1]
        finally:
            tracemalloc.stop()
        with patch.object(sabre,'_plan_sabre_trial',wraps=sabre._plan_sabre_trial) as trials:
            run(name)
        counts[name] = trials.call_count
    row = {'case': [width,family,topology], 'seconds': samples, 'median_seconds': {name: statistics.median(value) for name,value in samples.items()}, 'traced_python_peak_bytes': allocations, 'planner_calls_per_complete_workflow': counts, 'metrics': {name: routing(payload,f,None,case,0) for name,payload in payloads.items()}}
    rows.append(row)
    print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
Path('/private/tmp/fq-trial-stream-resources-20261122.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scope': 'Shared-host development observations; no qualified latency, process RSS, ranking or scalability claim', 'warmups': 2, 'retained_samples': 7, 'order': 'three-variant rotation', 'rows': rows, 'driver_source': Path(__file__).read_text()},indent=2)+'\n')
